welcome:
Welcome to the GitHub Actions CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated CI/CD environment.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: A developer reports the CI pipeline is broken. List recent workflow runs to find failures.
Run 7834521 failed on the 'CI Pipeline' workflow. View its details to find which job failed.
The 'test' job failed. View the logs for that specific job to see the error.
The test failure looks like a flaky integration test. Check what secrets are available in case a DB credential expired.
The DB_PASSWORD secret was last updated 90 days ago. Update it with the new credential.
Now re-run the failed jobs only (not the entire workflow) to save time.
Watch the re-run in real time to see if it passes now.
The run passed. Download the test artifacts to verify coverage reports.
List all available workflows to find the deployment pipeline.
View the 'Deploy Production' workflow details to check its trigger configuration.
Before deploying, check that the latest CI on main is green using PR checks.
CI is green. Trigger the production deployment workflow manually with the release tag.
steps.expect: gh workflow run deploy-production.yml -f environment=production -f version=v2.4.1
steps.hint: Try: gh workflow run deploy-production.yml -f environment=production -f version=v2.4.1

steps.instruction: List recent runs to find the triggered deployment run ID.
Watch run 7834590 as it progresses through build, test, and deploy stages.
Deployment succeeded. Create a GitHub release to mark this version.
steps.expect: gh release create v2.4.1 --title "v2.4.1" --notes "Production release with payment gateway fix"
steps.hint: Try: gh release create v2.4.1 --title "v2.4.1" --notes "Production release with payment gateway fix"

steps.instruction: Verify the release was created and list recent releases.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  gh run list                    — List recent workflow runs
  gh run view <run-id>           — View a workflow run
  gh run watch <run-id>          — Watch a run in progress
  gh run rerun <run-id>          — Re-run a workflow
  gh run cancel <run-id>         — Cancel a workflow run
  gh run download <run-id>       — Download run artifacts
  gh workflow list               — List workflows
  gh workflow view <file>        — View workflow details
  gh workflow run <file>         — Trigger a workflow
  gh workflow enable <file>      — Enable a workflow
  gh workflow disable <file>     — Disable a workflow
  gh secret list                 — List repository secrets
  gh secret set <name>           — Set a secret
  gh secret delete <name>        — Delete a secret
  gh variable list               — List repository variables
  gh variable set <name>         — Set a variable
  gh pr checks <pr>              — View CI checks on a PR
  gh release create              — Create a release
  gh release list                — List releases
  gh api                         — Query the GitHub API

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
